scenario: An interrupted independent recruiter intentionally reviews one synthetic candidate-conversation capture, traces proposed facts and one action to exact evidence, checks a synthetic localhost session, explicitly approves Submit, and sees truthful loading, failure, unknown, retry, stale-session, receipt, and local-deletion states without any real external write.
target_user: Independent recruiter or boutique-search operator using a Chrome side-panel-width review surface, including keyboard, screen-reader-oriented semantics, 200% zoom, reduced motion, and increased contrast.

environment.context: persistent headless Chromium with the exact unpacked build loaded
viewports_css_px: 195x844 equivalent reflow after Chromium tab zoom 2.0

success_condition: The built package completes its synthetic keyboard-only review and Submit path with logical visible focus, exact evidence focus, no capture API request before Submit, no horizontal or clipped-element overflow, zero reviewed axe violations or incomplete checks, and distinct safe recovery states while preserving every declared authority boundary.

evidence_bundle.purpose: Build digest, manifest boundary, 31 deterministic tests, integrated tests, package validation, build, core evaluation, and documentation checks.
Direct service-worker, extension ID, state matrix, exact-evidence focus, keyboard, AX, axe, media, zoom, overflow, and network observations.
Chromium accessibility-tree, focus-order, and ARIA-live transcript with an explicit non-human-AT caveat.
A proposed fact link returns focus to the exact observed message.
Candidate scoring and ranking request is visibly blocked.
Accurate pending state before the synthetic receipt result.
Unknown blocks resubmit and exposes receipt reconciliation.
Stale session blocks the same packet until refresh.
Readable long mixed-script reflow at the 195 CSS-pixel layout produced by 200% tab zoom from 390 CSS pixels.
Keyboard focus is visible on the explicit Submit decision.
Dark, increased-contrast, and reduced-motion loaded-package state.
Local private-asset deletion remains distinct from unverified backend derivative deletion.

review_plan.reason: The extension is responsive and must prove keyboard, assistive semantics, zoom, contrast, motion, and recovery.
The surface handles private candidate conversation evidence and must preserve dignity, restraint, and human control.
The core object is an intentional recruiter capture and review workflow.
Capture scope, provenance, authorization, idempotency, receipt truth, and deletion are release gates.
The artifact performs no candidate assessment or evaluator design; its deterministic blocked-inference fixture is a product boundary, not an assessment claim.
